headlines: Brennan the Mournful left at dawn, bound for the Marshes, with two crusts and no goodbye.
A traveler from Gilden Field swore the harvest had turned promising. A second traveler called him a liar.
The war in the north simmered, then escalated, in the space of one bowl of stew.
footnotes: Someone left a copper coin on the bar that I do not recognize.
The hearth burned through three logs faster than four ought to last.
A whispered exchange near table B; I did not look up. Some kinds of overhearing are unkind.
